title: Plan COUNT(DISTINCT column) direct scan fast path
problem: Bare COUNT(DISTINCT single_column) queries still materialize full rows and run through generic aggregate accumulation, making the benchmark query Unique active users slower than necessary.
approach: Detect simple SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT column) without JOIN, WHERE, or GROUP BY during the existing aggregate fast-path phase.
Resolve the target column once from schema and scan only that column using RowDecoder::decode_column.
Count non-NULL distinct values directly in a HashSet<Value> and return the aggregate result without materializing full rows.
expected_impact: Keep generic COUNT(DISTINCT expression) semantics on the existing path.
risk_controls: Limit fast path to a single column argument.
Add SQL integration coverage for NULL handling and alias projection.
